slides: Stuck at a desk? Move in 30‑second bursts.
Each micro‑burst spikes blood flow.
The spike wakes dormant mitochondria.
Waking them boosts daily energy without extra gym time.
Takeaway: 5×30‑sec moves a day equal a short walk.
Your future self hates today’s excuses.
Excuses are shortcuts that bypass the feedback loop.
Feedback is the only map that tells you if you’re heading right.
When you force the loop, tiny wins compound into habit.
Takeaway: Write one tiny task that proves tomorrow you kept a promise.
Breath is the hidden lever of lifespan.
Slow nasal inhalations lengthen the exhale.
Longer exhales activate parasympathetic calm.
Calm reduces cortisol spikes that age cells.
Takeaway: 4‑4‑6 breathing for 2 minutes before sleep extends cellular health.
Momentum isn’t magic; it’s a chain of anchors.
An anchor is a ritual you repeat the same way each day.
Consistency turns the anchor into a cue for the next action.
Cue → action → reward creates a self‑reinforcing loop.
Takeaway: Choose one 5‑minute anchor now; let it pull the rest of the day.
